notes: Easier choices and progress bars that never start empty. Every progress bar now starts with a head start and is full only when you finish; badges, the daily goal, the Map and shop coin bars, the HSK course bar and the word bank count down what is left ("2 to go") once you are halfway or before you start. Screens show one obvious button: the end of a writing round with missed words, the end of Prove words, an empty deck's Add cards. On the Decks page the New deck button is an outline under Learn now, and Pick up where you left off only shows a story you are reading, not a deck already listed.
